summary: 46-year-old hunter fell off his horse near Hell Roaring trailhead, injuring his leg, hip and arm and unable to walk out. 8 MRA field members plus support responded; patient carried back to the hunting camp and driven down the muddy access road to a waiting ambulance by ~10:45 PM.
location: Hell Roaring trailhead area, ~1/4 mi downhill from the hunting camp near the end of Capitol Creek Road, ~8 mi west of Aspen
